name: 4 Years in Tehran
source:
The story is about a rural girl who comes to the Iranian capital to develop and continue her education, but the president of the university does not agree to offer her a student dormitory.
Mahsa (The first role of the story) is forced to live temporarily with a new family,
which is not normal anything in this family . . .​

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/Monia_Se]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述了一名农村女孩来到伊朗首都发展和继续学业，但大学校长不同意为她提供学生宿舍。
Mahsa（故事的第一个角色）被迫暂时与新家庭住在一起，
这在这个家庭里是不正常的事情。。.​

[来自[url=https://www.patreon.com/Monia_Se]Patreon[/url]]
